cohort_filter: ICD K29.* (gastritis / duodenitis) on hospital admissions
description: 12 structured csv files (7 top-level + 4 icu + 1 multimodal/notes). scorer grades all 12 via equal_file_row_aligned_v1. summary.json must live OUTSIDE this reference directory (e.g. reference/_meta/summary.json) so the row-aligned scorer does not pick it up; the harness enforces this via preflight.

demographics.csv.notes: subject-keyed, may have multiple rows per subject (anchor_year × valueuom-like breakdown)

medications.csv.notes: all 8 columns used as a composite key; raw may contain ~6 dup rows after compression

icu/chartevents.csv.notes: all 7 columns used as a composite key; raw may contain ~70 dup rows after compression

_auxiliary_files._comment: summary.json is intentionally NOT in 'files'. scorer would error trying to extract columns from a JSON document. Keep summary.json OUTSIDE the reference directory tree the scorer walks (e.g. move it to <split>/reference/_meta/summary.json or <split>/_meta/summary.json).
